concerns.text: FR-008 and SC-004 require evaluating the Learned Sparse baseline over 5 independent seeds and aggregating results for statistical comparison. Tasks T026a (seeded runner) and T026b (aggregation) are marked as rejected/missing in the analyze report, leaving the core statistical validity of the experiment unimplementable.

FR-002 requires generating full attention maps and extracting ground truth via RTPurbo. Task T012 is marked as rejected/missing, blocking the entire downstream pipeline (US1, US2, US3) as no ground truth labels can be generated.
Edge Case handling for documents with zero RTPurbo tokens is required by spec.md. Task T016 is marked as rejected/missing, risking skewed statistical results if anomalies are not excluded.

SC-002 requires measuring perplexity against baselines. Tasks T027 (static runner) and T026a (learned runner) are marked as rejected/missing, preventing the calculation of performance drop required for SC-002.
SC-004 requires a paired t-test. Task T029 depends on T019c and T026b. Since T026b (aggregated baseline results) is rejected/missing, the statistical test cannot be performed.
SC-006 and FR-008 (Plan alignment) require Cross-Model Validation on Gemma-2. Tasks T033 and T034 are unchecked and lack implementation, leaving a mandatory success criterion unaddressed.
SC-005 requires measuring execution time against a 6-hour limit. Tasks T032 and T032b are marked as rejected/missing, so the feasibility constraint cannot be verified.

Assumption A1 and Constitution Principle I require a reproducible environment. Tasks T001 (structure), T003 (linting), and T004 (pytest) are marked as rejected/missing, preventing the foundational environment for data download (T011).
Constitution Principle VI requires a <1% performance drop check. Task T031 is marked as rejected/missing, meaning the falsifiability condition is not satisfied.
